newsitem.title: USA: CNA unit launches agricultural Web site.
newsitem.headline: CNA unit launches agricultural Web site.

text.p: CNA Agriculture Technology & Services Inc, a unit of CNA Financial Corp, said Thursday it launched a site on the Internet's World Wide Web designed to meet the information needs of the agricultural community.

The site will offer data on CNA's agricultural risk management products, late-breaking agriculture insurance industry news, comprehensive weather conditions and forecasts and pricing information on stocks, options and commodities.
The company said the site will be particularly of interest to its registered crop insurance agents, who will be able to access product brochures and communicate with CNA managers.
CNA Financial is an insurance holding company.
Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 114-1/2.
